name: Caffè Nero
covers: Drinks and food in GB Caffè Nero shops
headline: Any milk but oat drink.
tips: Any milk but oat: the guide lists oats as a gluten cereal. A few drinks come with oat as standard, so ask for another milk.
Almost all the bakery, panini, sandwiches and cakes contain wheat. Look at the popcorn, crisps, yoghurts and fruit pots.
Whipped cream: the guide's figures for some drinks don't include it, so the allergen table lists it on its own.
gaps: Caffè Nero marks a few products GF (its gluten free label) and names one Tostati gluten free. This app lists items whose ingredients name no gluten cereal, and quotes those claims.
The guide says it lists oats as an allergen even when they're gluten free oats, and that those products may not suit people with coeliac disease because of in-store handling.
Some extras, sauces and syrups are only in the guide's allergen table, which shows allergens but not ingredients.
The guide says it can't guarantee an allergen free environment because equipment is shared.
